dn26:14.1: iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane nānuppadiyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi dāḷiddiye vepullaṃ gate adinnādānaṃ vepullamagamāsi adinnādāne vepullaṃ gate satthaṃ vepullamagamāsi satthe vepullaṃ gate pāṇātipāto vepullamagamāsi pāṇātipāte vepullaṃ gate musāvādo vepullamagamāsi musāvāde vepullaṃ gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyupi parihāyi vaṇṇopi parihāyi
dn26:14.2: tesaṃ āyunāpi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi parihāyamānānaṃ asītivassasahasusāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ cattārīsavassasahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ
dn26:14.3: cattārīsavassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi.
dn26:14.6: ayaṃ deva puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyīti.
dn26:14.7: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto taṃ purisaṃ etadavoca
dn26:14.8: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ ambho purisa paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyasīti.
dn26:15.1: iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane nānuppadiyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi dāḷiddiye vepullaṃ gate adinnādānaṃ vepullamagamāsi adinnādāne vepullaṃ gate satthaṃ vepullamagamāsi satthe vepullaṃ gate pāṇātipāto vepullamagamāsi pāṇātipāte vepullaṃ gate musāvādo vepullamagamāsi musāvāde vepullaṃ gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyupi parihāyi vaṇṇopi parihāyi
dn26:15.2: tesaṃ āyunāpi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi parihāyamānānaṃ cattārīsavassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ
dn26:15.3: vīsativassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi.

dn26:17.2: tattha ye te sattā dubbaṇṇā te vaṇṇavante satte abhijjhāyantā paresaṃ dāresu cārittaṃ āpajjiṃsu.
dn26:17.3: iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane nānuppadiyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi dāḷiddiye vepullaṃ gate adinnādānaṃ vepullamagamāsi adinnādāne vepullaṃ gate. saṅkhittaṃ. kāmesu micchācāro vepullamagamāsi kāmesu micchācāre vepullaṃ gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyupi parihāyi vaṇṇopi parihāyi

dn26:17.5: pañcavassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu dve dhammā vepullamagamiṃsu pharusā
dn26:17.7: dvīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyupi parihāyi vaṇṇopi parihāyi

dn26:17.10: abhijjhābyāpādesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyupi parihāyi vaṇṇopi parihāyi
dn26:17.11: tesaṃ āyunāpi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi parihāyamānānaṃ aḍḍhateyyavassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vassasahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ
dn26:17.13: micchādiṭṭhiyā vepullaṃ gatāya tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyupi parihāyi vaṇṇopi parihāyi
dn26:17.14: tesaṃ āyunāpi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi parihāyamānānaṃ vassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ pañcavassasatāyukā puttā ahesuṃ
dn26:17.15: pañcavassasatāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tayo dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu
dn26:17.17: tīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyupi parihāyi vaṇṇopi parihāyi
dn26:17.18: tesaṃ āyunāpi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi parihāyamānānaṃ pañcavassasatāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ appekacce aḍḍhateyyavassasatāyukā appekacce dvevassasatāyukā puttā ahesuṃ
dn26:17.19: aḍḍhateyyavassasatāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ime dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu
dn26:18.1: iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane nānuppadiyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi
dn26:18.6: musāvāde vepullaṃ gate pisuṇā vācā vepullamagamāsi
dn26:18.7: pisuṇāya vācāya vepullaṃ gatāya kāmesu micchācāro vepullamagamāsi
dn26:18.8: kāmesu micchācāre vepullaṃ gate dve dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu pharusā ca vācā samphappalāpo ca
dn26:18.9: dvīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu abhijjhābyāpādā vepullamagamaṃsu
dn26:18.11: micchādiṭṭhiyā vepullaṃ gatāya tayo dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu adhammarāgo visamalobho micchādhammo
dn26:18.12: tīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu ime dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā abrahmaññatā nakulejeṭṭhāpacāyitā
dn26:18.13: imesu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyupi parihāyi vaṇṇopi parihāyi
dn26:18.14: tesaṃ āyunāpi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi parihāyamānānaṃ aḍḍhateyyavassasatāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vassasatāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:19.1: bhavissati bhikkhave so samayo yaṃ imesaṃ manussānaṃ dasavassāyukā puttā bhavissanti
dn26:19.2: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu pañcavassikā kumārikā alaṃpateyyā bhavissanti
dn26:19.3: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu imāni rasāni antaradhāyissanti seyyathīdaṃ
dn26:19.4: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ
dn26:19.5: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu kudrusako aggabhojanaṃ bhavissati
dn26:19.7: evameva kho bhikkhave dasavassāyukesu manussesu kudrusako aggabhojanaṃ bhavissati
dn26:19.8: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu dasa kusalakammapathā sabbena sabbaṃ antaradhāyissanti dasa akusalakammapathā ativiya dippissanti
dn26:19.9: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu kusalantipi na bhavissati kuto pana kusalassa kārako
dn26:19.10: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ye te bhavissanti amatteyyā apetteyyā asāmaññā abrahmaññā nakulejeṭṭhāpacāyino te pūjāca bhavissanti pāsaṃsā ca
dn26:19.11: seyyathāpi bhikkhave etarahi matteyyā petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kulejeṭṭhāpacāyino te pūjā ca pāsaṃsā ca
dn26:19.12: evameva kho bhikkhave dasavassāyukesu manussesu ye te bhavissanti amatteyyā apetteyyā asāmaññā abrahmaññā nakulejeṭṭhāpacāyino te pūjā ca bhavissanti pāsaṃsā ca
dn26:20.1: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu na bhavissati mātāti vā mātucchāti vā pitāti vā pitucchāti vā mātulānīti vā ācariyabhariyāti vā garūnaṃ dārāti vā
dn26:20.2: sambhedaṃ loko gamissati yathā ajeḷakā kukkuṭā sūkarā soṇā sigālā
dn26:20.3: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ aññamaññamhi tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo byāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ
dn26:20.6: bhātupi bhaginiyā. bhaginiyā bhātari tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo byāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ
dn26:20.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave māgavikassa migaṃ disvā tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito hoti tibbo byāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ
dn26:20.8: evameva kho bhikkhave dasavassāyukesu manussesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ aññamaññamhi tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo byāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ
dn26:20.11: bhātupi 2 bhaginiyā. bhaginiyāpi bhātari tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo byāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ.
dn26:21.1: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu sattāhaṃ satthantarakappo bhavissati
dn26:21.4: te tiṇhena satthena esa migoti aññamaññaṃ jīvitā voropissanti.
dn26:21.5: athakho tesaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ ekaccānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati
dn26:21.6: mā ca mayaṃ kañci mā ca amhe koci yannūna mayaṃ tiṇagahaṇaṃ vā vanagahaṇaṃ vā rukkhagahaṇaṃ vā nadīviduggaṃ vā pabbatavisamaṃ vā pavisitvā vanamūlaphalāhārā yāpeyyāmāti.
dn26:21.7: te tiṇagahaṇaṃ vā vanagahaṇaṃ vā rukkhagahaṇaṃ vā nadīviduggaṃ vā pabbatavisamaṃ vā pavisitvā sattāhaṃ vanamūlaphalāhārā yāpessanti.
dn26:21.8: te tassa sattāhassa accayena tiṇagahaṇā vanagahaṇā rukkhagahaṇā nadīviduggā pabbatavisamā nikkhamitvā aññamaññaṃ āliṅgitvā sabhāsu gāyissanti samassāsissanti
dn26:21.9: diṭṭhā bho sattā jīvasi tvaṃ diṭṭhā bho sattā jīvasīti.
dn26:21.12: mayaṃ kho akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu evarūpaṃ āyataṃ ñātikkhayaṃ pattā
dn26:21.15: yannūna mayaṃ pāṇātipātā virameyyāma idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmāti.
dn26:21.16: te pāṇātipātā viramissanti idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti
dn26:21.17: te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti
dn26:21.18: tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ dasavassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:22.1: athakho tesaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati
dn26:22.2: mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma
dn26:22.3: yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyoso mattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma
dn26:22.16: yannūna mayaṃ matteyyā assāma petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kule jeṭṭhāpacāyino idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmāti.
dn26:22.17: te matteyyā bhavissanti petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kule jeṭṭhāpacāyino idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti
dn26:22.18: tesaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti
dn26:22.19: tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vīsativassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ cattāḷīsavassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:23.3: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu pañcavassasatikā kumārikā alaṃpateyyā bhavissanti.
dn26:23.5: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tayo ābādhā bhavissanti icchā anasanaṃ jarā.
dn26:23.6: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ jambudīpo iddho ceva bhavissati phīto ca kukkuṭasampātitā gāmanigamarājadhāniyo.
dn26:23.7: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ jambudīpo avīci maññe phuṭo bhavissati manussehi seyyathāpi naḷavanaṃ vā sāravanaṃ vā.
dn26:23.8: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ bārāṇasī ketumatī nāma rājadhānī bhavissati iddhā ceva phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.
dn26:23.9: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu imasmiṃ jambudīpe caturāsītinagarasahassāni bhavissanti ketumatirājadhānīpamukhāni.
dn26:24.1: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ketumatīrājadhāniyā saṅkho nāma rājā uppajjissati cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadaṭṭhāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
dn26:24.3: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthīratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
dn26:24.4: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavissanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn26:24.5: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasissati.
dn26:25.1: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu metteyyo nāma bhagavā loke uppajjissati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
dn26:25.2: seyyathāpāhametarahi loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
dn26:25.3: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedessati seyyathāpāhametarahi imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedemi.
dn26:25.4: so dhammaṃ desessati ādikalāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsessati
dn26:25.5: seyyathāpāhametarahi dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
dn26:25.6: so anekasahassaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissati seyyathāpāhaṃ etarahi anekasataṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharāmi.
dn26:26.1: athakho bhikkhave saṅkho nāma rājā yo so yūpo raññā mahāpanādena kārāpito
dn26:26.2: taṃ yūpaṃ ussāpetvā ajjhāvasitvā vissajjitvā samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikavaṇibbakayācakānaṃ dānaṃ datvā metteyyassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati.
dn26:26.3: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati.
dn26:27.1: attadīpā bhikkhave viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.
dn26:27.2: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
dn26:27.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
dn26:27.4: vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
dn26:27.5: citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
dn26:27.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn26:27.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
dn26:28.1: gocare bhikkhave caratha sake pettike visaye.
dn26:28.2: gocare bhikkhave carantā sake pettike visaye āyunāpi vaḍḍhissatha vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissatha sukhenapi vaḍḍhissatha bhogenapi vaḍḍhissatha balenapi vaḍḍhissatha.
dn26:28.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāvetiviriyasamādhipadhāna…
dn26:28.8: so imesaṃ catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
dn26:28.11: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
dn26:28.14: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
dn26:28.20: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
dn26:28.23: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
dn26:28.26: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavañcetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn26:28.28: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekabalampi samanupassāmi evaṃ duppasahaṃ yathāyidaṃ bhikkhave mārabalaṃ
dn26:28.29: kusalānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ samādānahetu evamidaṃ puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatīti.
dn26:28.31: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
